     patch, the same for the CLS token, and a model-level Wasserstein
     distance. Transcribed from pp. 29-33 of the earlier GELOS talk; figures
     are the originals, in images/fire/. The results slides are title plus
     figure, as in the source; suggested takeaways are left in comments. -->

## GELOS Fire {#fire-dataset}

::: {.two-col}
- [3,949]{.hl} events vs [10,345]{.hl} control (as long as S2 is available), totaling [171,528]{.hl} samples
- Four time points per year (one per quarter)
- Sentinel-1 RTC, Sentinel-2 Level 2A, Landsat (8 & 9), I/O Landcover, fire mask (MTBS and S2 WCD)
- GSD 960 m × 960 m
  - 96 × 96 pixels for S1/S2
  - 32 × 32 for Landsat

![](images/fire/example-chips.png){fig-alt="Example sample: burned-area mask, annual landcover, four quarterly images for the 2023 event year, and four quarterly images for each control year from 2022 back to 2018."}
:::

<!-- Suggestion: the figure has no caption in the source. Something like
